whenToUse: A writer's or editor's newsletter that needs a subscribe form, a searchable archive and single-issue pages.
Solo publications where the latest letter and reader replies sell the subscription.
avoidWhen: Multi-author publications with categories and feeds — use site-blog-01.
a11y: The subscribe state is announced through a role="status" live region; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Keep the typo hint linked to the email field so it is read with the input.
